search_text: published ZDI-23-107 ZDI-CAN-19687 (Pwn2Own) Ubiquiti Networks EdgeOS dhcp6c Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-02-09 CVE-2023-23912 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-23912 7.5 AV:A/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Ubiquiti Networks'] ['EdgeOS'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Ubiquiti Networks EdgeOS. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the dhcp6c daemon. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Ubiquiti Networks has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: (Pwn2Own) Ubiquiti Networks EdgeOS dhcp6c Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Ubiquiti Networks EdgeOS. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the dhcp6c daemon. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
